requirements.normative_requirement: No host Unix socket or unexpected socket descriptor is mounted or inherited into the VM or cell.
requirements.primary_verification: Descriptor audit, filesystem socket search, and attempted Docker/SSH/Wayland/system bus access.

requirements.normative_requirement: Guest-local Unix sockets are permitted only inside isolated cell or workspace namespaces; the controller channel remains unreachable.
requirements.threat_or_failure: Compatibility breakage or cross-cell covert channel
requirements.primary_verification: Legitimate local socket workload plus cross-cell abstract and filesystem socket isolation tests.
